capabilities: Create manual version snapshots inside the note body
Switch which stored version is the editable note body
Show inline green/red word-level diffs between versions in Live Preview
Store history as Obsidian callouts with structured markers readable by agents and other tools
disambiguation: Not a git or sync tool; snapshots are created manually and stored as callouts inside the note file itself.
extras: Not yet in the Obsidian Community Plugins directory; must be installed via BRAT, and the README recommends testing in a disposable vault rather than a primary one. Local and offline: no network calls, self-update, or data leaving the vault.
motivation: The author wanted both version control over notes and a shared, readable format for discussing changes between drafts with an AI assistant.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in per-note version history that travels with the file itself and can be read by humans or AI tools without external databases.

relations.evidence: Install and enable the BRAT plugin from Community Plugins in a dedicated disposable vault

summary: Version-snapshot plugin that archives manual Markdown snapshots inside each note and shows inline word-level diffs between versions.
